# Module `lune_ui_core::motion`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core`](index.md)

Motion: the closed-form animation model (`docs/motion.md`). Every value is a pure function of
the app's [`Time`](motion.md#type.Time) and stored parameters; nothing integrates per frame and nothing reads a
clock, so a frame is reproducible.

- [`Easing`](motion.md#enum.Easing): the seven easings (`CUBIC_OUT` and `EASE_IN` are the moved menu curves).
- [`Lerp`](motion.md#trait.Lerp), [`Tween`](motion.md#struct.Tween), [`Keyframes`](motion.md#struct.Keyframes), [`Spring`](motion.md#struct.Spring): interpolable values and fixed runs.
- [`Transition`](motion.md#struct.Transition): a retargetable run that keeps its velocity when interrupted (D11).
- [`Token`](motion.md#enum.Token), [`Kind`](motion.md#enum.Kind), [`Motion`](motion.md#struct.Motion), [`MotionTier`](motion.md#enum.MotionTier), [`MotionTokens`](motion.md#struct.MotionTokens), [`MOTION`](motion.md#constant.MOTION): the
  vocabulary and the tier rules (D12).
- [`conformance`](motion.md#fn.conformance), [`conformance_of`](motion.md#fn.conformance_of): the 60 Hz harness (D41).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/motion.rs:1`

<a id="struct.Spring"></a>
### Struct `Spring`

```rust
pub struct Spring<T: Lerp> {
    pub target: T,
    pub rate: f32,
    pub x0: T,
    pub v0: T,
    pub start: Time,
}
```

A critically damped spring towards `target` from `x0` with velocity `v0` (units per second)
at `start`, angular rate `rate` (1/s): `x(t) = target + (d0 + (v0 + w·d0)·t)·e^(−w·t)` with
`d0 = x0 − target`. It never overshoots when `d0` and `v0` share a sign. There is no default
rate. A rate that is not a positive finite number holds `x0`.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/motion/tween.rs:154`

<a id="struct.Transition"></a>
### Struct `Transition`

```rust
pub struct Transition<T: Lerp> {
    // some fields omitted
}
```

A value moving towards its latest target (D11). From a settled state a retarget is a plain
tween; a retarget while in flight starts from the current value and adds a Hermite term
`K·p(1 − p)²` with `K = v·d − (target − current)·E′(0)` so the velocity carries over. A sample
at or after the end returns the target exactly and reports settled.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/motion/transition.rs:14`

**Methods and associated items**

`impl<T: Lerp> Transition<T>`

- <a id="method.Transition.in_flight"></a>`pub fn in_flight(&self, now: Time) -> bool`

  Whether the transition is still moving at `now`.

- <a id="method.Transition.retarget"></a>`pub fn retarget(&mut self, now: Time, target: T, duration: Duration, easing: Easing)`

  Moves towards `target` over `duration` with `easing`, starting at `now`: a plain tween
  from the current value when settled, velocity-preserving when in flight. A zero duration
  snaps.

- <a id="method.Transition.sample"></a>`pub fn sample(&self, now: Time) -> (T, bool)`

  The value at `now` and whether it is still in flight; exactly the target and `false` once
  `now` reaches the end. Time before the start samples the start value.

- <a id="method.Transition.settled"></a>`pub fn settled(value: T) -> Self`

  At rest on `value`; never in flight until retargeted.

<a id="enum.Easing"></a>
### Enum `Easing`

```rust
pub enum Easing {
    Linear,
    QuadOut,
    QuadIn,
    SineInOut,
    BackOut,
    CubicBezier(f32, f32, f32, f32),
}
```

An easing: maps progress 0..1 to eased progress, clamping outside 0..1.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/motion/easing.rs:55`

**Variants**

- <a id="variant.Easing.Linear"></a>`Linear`

  `t`: hover and colour, focus.

- <a id="variant.Easing.QuadOut"></a>`QuadOut`

  `1 − (1 − t)²`: enter, press.

- <a id="variant.Easing.QuadIn"></a>`QuadIn`

  `t²`: exit.

- <a id="variant.Easing.SineInOut"></a>`SineInOut`

  `−(cos(πt) − 1) / 2`: move, resize.

- <a id="variant.Easing.BackOut"></a>`BackOut`

  `1 + c3 (t − 1)³ + c1 (t − 1)²`, `c1 = 1.70158`, `c3 = c1 + 1`: overshoots 1, emphasis only.

- <a id="variant.Easing.CubicBezier"></a>`CubicBezier(f32, f32, f32, f32)`

  CSS `cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2)`, evaluated by [`cubic_bezier`](motion.md#fn.cubic_bezier).

`impl Easing`

- <a id="associatedconstant.Easing.CUBIC_OUT"></a>`const CUBIC_OUT: Easing = _;`

- <a id="associatedconstant.Easing.EASE_IN"></a>`const EASE_IN: Easing = _;`

- <a id="method.Easing.derivative"></a>`pub fn derivative(self, t: f32) -> f32`

  d(eval)/dt at `t`, `t` clamped to 0..1. A cubic-bezier is solved for its curve parameter
  with the same bisection as [`eval`](motion.md#method.Easing.eval); where the curve's x slope vanishes the
  slope is a central difference of `eval` instead.

- <a id="method.Easing.eval"></a>`pub fn eval(self, t: f32) -> f32`

  Eased progress at `t`, `t` clamped to 0..1.

- <a id="method.Easing.inverse"></a>`pub fn inverse(self, y: f32) -> f32`

  The progress `t` in 0..1 at which `eval(t)` reaches `y`, by bisection. Meaningful only
  for monotone easings: `BackOut` overshoots, so its result is one of the crossings and is
  not supported. `y` outside the curve's range gives the nearest end.

```rust

) -> Result<Conformance, ConformanceError>
```

Runs `motion` from `from` to `to` under `tier` with `tokens`: a [`Transition`](motion.md#struct.Transition) settled on
`from` and retarget at time 0 (snapped when the tier resolves to no motion), checked by
[`conformance_of`](motion.md#fn.conformance_of) with a step bound of [`STEP_BOUND`](motion.md#constant.STEP_BOUND) (or [`STEP_BOUND_BACK_OUT`](motion.md#constant.STEP_BOUND_BACK_OUT)) times
`from.distance(to)`.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/motion/conformance.rs:90`

<a id="fn.conformance_of"></a>
### Function `conformance_of`

```rust
pub fn conformance_of<T: Lerp>(
    sampler: impl FnMut(Time) -> (T, bool),
    end: Time,
    target: T,
    bound: f32,
) -> Result<Conformance, ConformanceError>
```

Checks any sampler `t -> (value, in_flight)` on the 60 Hz grid from time 0: no step between
consecutive samples longer than `bound` (`Jump`), every sample finite (`NotFinite`), the first
sample at or after `end` exactly `target` and settled (`End`, which is also how a late
settle reports), and no sample in flight again after the first settled one (`Late`). Sampling stops two frames after
the first settled sample.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/motion/conformance.rs:122`

### Function `spin_angle`

```rust
pub fn spin_angle(t: Time) -> f32
```

Spinner angle in degrees at `t`: `360 · frac(t / 1200 ms)`, from the app's time so it does not
accumulate per frame. This is the raw phase, whatever the tier: the spinner widget decides by
tier (a turning glyph under Full, a static one at angle 0 under Reduced and Off, D117).
